name: Aecc Aero Science and Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Aecc Aero Science and Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the production and manufacturing of aero-engine and gas turbine components in China. The company was formerly known as Sichuan Chengfa Aero-Science & Technology Co,Ltd. and changed its name to Aecc Aero Science and Technology Co.,Ltd in April 2017. Aecc Aero Science and Technology Co.,Ltd was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
